Book club name generator

Pick a theme and a style, and get six name ideas for your club. Click again for more; the combinations run into the thousands.

    TL;DR
    • Choose a theme (nonfiction, novels, business, calm, languages) and a style.
    • Every click gives six new names.
    • Shortlist three and let your members vote.

    How to choose a good club name

    A good name tells people who the club is for or what it reads, is short enough to say in a sentence and fits a group-chat title. Avoid names that lock the club into one genre if you might change later. Shortlist three, check that nobody nearby already uses them, and let members vote at the first meeting.

    Need the rest of the setup? Our guide on how to start a book club covers size, rules and the first meeting.

    Questions people ask

    What is a good name for a book club?

    A good book club name is short, easy to say and hints at who the club is for or what it reads, such as a city, a genre or a shared joke. It should work as a group-chat title and still fit if your reading changes. Shortlist a few and let members vote.

    Should a book club name be funny?

    It depends on the group. Friends' clubs often pick playful names, while workplace or school clubs usually prefer something simple and professional. A light pun works for most groups. Whatever the tone, make sure new members would understand the name without an explanation.

    Are these names free to use?

    Yes, the generator combines common words, so you can use any name for your club. If you plan to build a brand, website or paid community around the name, search online first to make sure another group or company isn't already using it.
